instruction: Candid street photograph, low-angle full shot looking up outdoor stone stairs in a narrow alleyway. On the left, the man in the white suit and white wings (R2) walks down the steps, looking forward. On the right, the woman in the black dress and black wings (R1) walks beside him, also looking forward. The man and the woman hold hands as they walk side-by-side down the staircase. The scene is illuminated by warm natural daylight, casting soft shadows on the stone steps and warm-toned walls.
